editorial.blurb: This Wicker Park family-owned tavern serves generous portions of beautifully plated American and Italian fare in a stunning space with an open roof and garden patio.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the wings—reviewers consistently rave about their generous size and thick, flavorful dipping sauce—and ask your server (like Crystal or Jade) for personalized recommendations; the chef is known to step in with suggestions on standout dishes like the black mussels and boiled pork chop.
signatureDishes: Boiled pork chop with yukon potatoes and broccoli
